content.comment_body: I recently purchased a [company_name] [product_name] [article_no] to replace the previous one I used for about three years, which had failed. The old unit was programmed for a submersible sewer pump and floats. Although the new unit powers up, it lacks those pump control features. I am wondering if the previous [product_name] in the control panel included additional programming that I now need to obtain separately. If so, could someone share information on where to acquire the appropriate software?

I'm not sure I understand your question. Regarding software: do you already have [product_name] installed? If yes, you can download the upgrade to the current [version_no] for free, including instructions for installation. If you don't have it, you need to purchase it; the order number from [company_name] is [product_name] [version_no] [article_no].
